content.text: The text is an extensive medical index covering diseases, symptoms, pathology, diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment. Major sections address liver and biliary disorders, including lithaemia, jaundice, hepatitis, cirrhosis, abscesses, cancers, fatty and amyloid degeneration, gallstones, biliary obstruction, portal-vein disease, and hepatic parasites. It also covers pancreatic disease, peritonitis, ascites, oesophageal, gastric, intestinal, rectal, and pharyngeal disorders. Additional entries discuss rheumatism, rheumatoid arthritis, scrofula, scurvy, syphilis, rachitis, purpura, stomatitis, tonsillitis, parasitic infections, and nutritional or metabolic conditions such as diabetes. Treatments include dietary and hygienic measures, medicines, mineral waters, bathing, enemata, electricity, drainage, puncture, and surgical procedures.
